Al(111) 2x2x3 slab with N2 placed at an explicitly computed bridge midpoint of two nearest top Al atoms, count 14=3k+2, Al/N types printed.
Pt(111) OH on ontop/bridge/fcc via add_adsorbate gives three distinct EMT energies plus an explicit lowest-site statement.
Au primitive bulk with FrechetCellFilter+LBFGS fmax=0.01 prints step count (2) and final energy near the EMT equilibrium reference.
Ni PreconLBFGS(precon='auto')+EMT prints steps, final energy, and cell lengths/angles all finite.
Bussi NVT 500K Ag 2x2x2 200 steps prints 4 temperature samples every 50 steps, all within the plausible band.
Ramp target temperature genuinely changes each step via dyn.temp updates, but the printed samples (244,307,257,215K) show no clear upward trend due to small-cell noise.
VelocityVerlet NVE Pd 2x2x2 500K 200 steps prints the explicit total-energy difference 6.65e-04 eV, well under the conservation threshold.
NPTBerendsen Cu 3x3x3 300K/1bar 200 steps prints initial and final volume and pressure, with modest volume change (<1%).
Pressure correctly converted from GPa to eV/A^3 and volumes printed, but the volume barely changes (132.860250->132.860177), making compression effectively invisible over 100 steps.

H2O vibrational modes printed in both cm^-1 and eV, but the bend-mode value (194.02 cm^-1) diverges from the closest computed reference (258.9 cm^-1) by roughly 25%, beyond tolerance, even though the two stretch modes match well.
CH4 optimized first then vibrated, real-frequency filtering applied, and printed values (2474.36 x3, 2649.05 cm^-1) match the reference set closely.
Manual 3-image linear-interpolation NEB on Al runs and prints all three image energies, but the middle image (3.48 eV) is lower than both endpoints (10.97 eV), a pathological band shape per rubric.

The equilibrium lattice constant formula a_eq=(4*v0)^(1/3) double-counts the already-4-atom conventional-cell volume, giving a wildly wrong a0=6.4506 A instead of ~4.064 A, even though the bulk modulus (99.8 GPa) is correct.
N2 vibration then IdealGasThermo with geometry='linear', symmetrynumber=2 prints Gibbs free energy -0.157761 eV, matching the optimized-geometry-with-Epot reference.
Cu bulk vibrations feed HarmonicThermo with real modes filtered, and a finite Helmholtz free energy -0.019715 eV is printed in eV.
Au FCC bulk written to XYZ and read back, atom types and positions both printed and consistent with the built structure.
NaCl crystal (sg225) written to CIF and read back, spacegroup (225 / F m -3 m) and atom count (8) both printed.
Cu bulk 10-step MD trajectory written and read back, frame count (11) and finite last-frame energy both printed.
Cu slabs with layers=2,3,4 key-value pairs stored; select(layers=3) retrieves the correct row and prints its 12-atom count.
FixAtoms correctly selects tags in {3,4} (the bottom two layers per fcc111 convention), and before/after coordinates for all fixed atoms are printed identical, confirming they did not move.
FixAtoms (bottom layer) and FixBondLength (C-O) applied simultaneously in one constraint list, BFGS to fmax=0.05, final energy and preserved C-O distance (1.15 A) both printed.
NeighborList with natural_cutoffs on Cu 3x3x3 gives average coordination number 12.00, matching the FCC reference.
get_distances(0, others, mic=True) on Cu 2x2x2 prints min=2.545584 and max=3.600000, both within tolerance of the primitive-cell reference.

The same a_eq=(4*v0)^(1/3) formula error as T36 causes the fitted equilibrium lattice constant to be reported as 5.698661 A instead of ~3.59 A, so the downstream slab is built with a grossly wrong lattice constant despite energy and per-layer z values being printed.
EOS fit correctly normalized by atom count for Cu, Ag, and Au gives a0/B values all within tolerance of the reference, presented in a comparison table.
